name: Nexent
description: Zero-code platform that generates agents from a prompt and runs them with shared tools, skills, memory and orchestration.
whatItDoes: Lets users describe an agent in natural language and have the platform build it. Intended for individuals, small teams and private infrastructure deployments.
howItWorks: A deploy script starts the services with Docker or Kubernetes, reading runtime settings from an env file under the deploy directory. Offline image packages can also be built.
